title: Music creation app for your games - supports CLAP and VST3 instruments and plugins
author: Mysterious_Spell9300
selftext:
Hello everyone! I apologize for such a pretentious video for my instrument.

I have created a tool for music creation and would like to share it with you. You can safely use the tracks it generates for your own projects (provided, of course, that you are using licensed software and plugins).

AI music generators often offer commercial licenses, terms can change at any time. Furthermore, your project might even see lower rankings if it contains detectable traces of AI generated content. I began developing this tool when I realized that while AI could help me create visuals for my game, I could not find a similarly simple tool for music creation.

This is a tool built by an enthusiast for other enthusiasts. It is definitely not intended for professionals and this is definitely not intended to replace existing professional tools. You can achieve a good level of quality, but it falls short of professional-grade software.

If you are interested, its a 100% free and here is the GitHub link:

[https://github.com/bigclumsypanda/nodaw-app](https://github.com/bigclumsypanda/nodaw-app)

I will release the source code once I have had a chance to clean it up a bit.

I recommend first connecting the tool (via MCP) to your agent, which will allow it to interface with your plugins or install additional utilities. You can then use the built-in chat once everything is properly set up.

comments.author: ex__hale
comments.body:
Wow, interesting

Which model will you recommend for better result?  
Maybe some tricks and tips from developer? 

Will try, thanks!

replies.author: Mysterious_Spell9300
replies.body: Thanks, mid-sized models will be perfectly capable of handling tasks. But the smarter the model, the better the result. However, it’s better to manage initial setup and the search for musical instruments via MCP. Since your Claude or Codex agent has internet access, it can assist with the installation and in most cases, it can even perform the setup itself if you just ask.
